{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment turns positive (0.67+), forecast prices must increase within 3 days to avoid lagging behind true outcomes",
    "Sentiment turning negative (0.00-0.33) requires price decline in forecast within 2 days matching true outcome direction",
    "Forecast prices overshoot true outcomes by 5-10% in early days; compress to 80-95% of true values by day 15",
    "Mean reversion rule: when price deviates 2+ standard deviations from 18-day mean, forecast must converge toward that mean within 5 days",
    "Sentiment strength modulation: moderate sentiment (0.33-0.67) yields 10-20% smaller price adjustments than strong sentiment (1.00) which requires full 25-30% correction",
    "When consecutive days show same sentiment, forecast prices should flatten rather than continue trending",
    "Mismatch between forecast price direction and sentiment signal requires aligning within 0.5 price units or 1% daily change"
] }
